source_as_recorded: The image colour converter could not start. The image was not imported.
target_as_recorded: တူဝ်ပိၼ်ႇသီႁၢင်ႈ တႄႇႁဵတ်းၵၢၼ်ဢမ်ႇလႆႈ။ ဢမ်ႇလႆႈဢဝ်ႁၢင်ႈၶဝ်ႈ။
rationale: Component startup failure and negative import result both explicit; not unsupported format or successful partial import.

source_as_recorded: The image has invalid or unsupported colour metadata.
target_as_recorded: ႁၢင်ႈၼႆႉမီးမႄႇတႃႇတေႇတႃႇသီ ဢၼ်ဢမ်ႇထုၵ်ႇမႅၼ်ႈ ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် ဢမ်ႇႁပ်ႉႁွင်း။
rationale: Exact disjunction retained: unsupported is not conflated with malformed. Describes metadata, not missing colors.

source_as_recorded: The image ends inside its colour metadata.
rationale: Explicit data truncation, not a visible image edge. Correct incomplete-metadata temporal relation for end-of-file diagnostic.

source_as_recorded: The original SVG size exceeds Android bitmap dimensions. No resizing was applied.
target_as_recorded: ၶၼၢတ်ႈ SVG ငဝ်ႈတိုၼ်း ပူၼ်ႉၶေႃႈမၵ်းၶၼ်ႈၶၼၢတ်ႈႁၢင်ႈၽိၵ်ႉသႄႇလ်ၶွင် Android။ ဢမ်ႇလႆႈလႅၵ်ႈၶၼၢတ်ႈသင်။
rationale: Dimension range rather than storage or RAM limit; Android/SVG retained. Explicit no resize, not an implicit downscale.

source_as_recorded: The SVG does not declare a usable original size. No canvas-based size was substituted.
target_as_recorded: SVG ၼႆႉဢမ်ႇမၵ်းဝႆႉၶၼၢတ်ႈငဝ်ႈတိုၼ်းဢၼ်ၸႂ်ႉလႆႈ။ ဢမ်ႇလႆႈဢဝ်ၶၼၢတ်ႈဢၼ်ဢိင်ပိုၼ်ႉတီႈတႅမ်ႈႁၢင်ႈမႃးတႅၼ်း။
rationale: Usable declaration failure is not mere absence of a file. Both no-usable-size and no-canvas-fallback preserved.

source_as_recorded: Writes plain text using light and dark characters. View it in a monospaced font. This is a visual rendition; it cannot be reopened as the original image.
target_as_recorded: တႅမ်ႈပဵၼ်လိၵ်ႈဢၼ်ဢမ်ႇတူၵ်ႇတႅင်ႇ လူၺ်ႈၸႂ်ႉတူဝ်လိၵ်ႈဢၼ်လႅင်းလႄႈမိုတ်း။ တူၺ်းလူၺ်ႈၾွၼ်ႉဢၼ်တူဝ်လိၵ်ႈၵူႈတူဝ်ၵႂၢင်ႈၽဵင်ႇၵၼ်။ ၼႆႉပဵၼ်ၵၢၼ်ၼႄႁၢင်ႈတႃႇတူၺ်းၵူၺ်း၊ ပိုတ်ႇၶိုၼ်းပဵၼ်ႁၢင်ႈငဝ်ႈတိုၼ်းဢမ်ႇလႆႈ။
rationale: Plain text and monospacing are accurate functional descriptions. Light/dark glyph appearance rather than colored font is intended. Visual-only and cannot-reopen-original warning both explicit.

source_as_recorded: %1$s exported. Your full drawing still has unsaved changes; save a full image copy before replacing it.
target_as_recorded: သူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇ %1$s ယဝ်ႉ။ ႁၢင်ႈတႅမ်ႈတင်းႁၢင်ႈၶွင်သူ ယင်းမီးလွင်ႈလႅၵ်ႈလၢႆႈဢၼ်ပႆႇလႆႈသိမ်း။ ဢွၼ်တၢင်းတေဢဝ်တၢင်ႇႁၢင်ႈတႅၼ်းမၼ်းၼၼ်ႉ သိမ်းၵေႃႇပီႇႁၢင်ႈတင်းႁၢင်ႈဝႆႉ။
rationale: Export success, still-unsaved full drawing, entire-image copy, and before-replacement order all remain explicit. မၼ်း refers to the drawing in this sequence, not a claim that the exported derivative is a full save. The added other-image wording explains replacement rather than changing the recovery instruction. Placeholder unchanged.

source_as_recorded: App language\n\nTranslations are maintained in AN Paint’s language resources. New or untranslated text appears in English.
target_as_recorded: ၽႃႇသႃႇဢႅပ်ႉ\n\nၶေႃႈပိၼ်ႇၽႃႇသႃႇၼႆႉ မီးၵၢၼ်လူလွမ်မႄးဝႆႉၼႂ်းၶေႃႈမုၼ်းၽႃႇသႃႇၶွင် AN Paint။ လိၵ်ႈမႂ်ႇ ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် လိၵ်ႈဢၼ်ပႆႇပိၼ်ႇ တေၼႄပဵၼ်ၽႃႇသႃႇဢင်းၵိတ်ႉ။
rationale: Maintenance is more than a one-time edit. Product name, two literal escaped newlines and new/untranslated English fallback are retained; no complete-coverage promise.

source_as_recorded: The completed image could not replace its destination.
target_as_recorded: ႁၢင်ႈဢၼ်ႁဵတ်းယဝ်ႉၼၼ်ႉ ဢဝ်တႅၼ်းသႂ်ႇတီႈသိမ်းဢမ်ႇလႆႈ။
rationale: Completed image is the object of failed replacement; တႅၼ်း carries replacement, not merely choosing a destination. Negation scopes the replacement, not image completion. Consistent with completed temporary encoding followed by failed rename in BitmapFileCodec.kt.

source_as_recorded: The image and encoding buffers exceed the export memory budget.
rationale: Complete compound retains image plus conversion buffers, exceed-limit predicate and export working-memory budget. New explicit conversion description resolves lexical hold; no device-storage or money meaning. Length is a UI-fit risk not assessed here, not a semantic omission.

Width × height in px, then angle on the next line. Exact indexed arguments, zero-decimal dimensions, one-decimal angle, degree sign, unit and one escaped newline retained. No English lexical text is present.
Numeric 100 percent label. Existing accepted Shan resources retain ASCII numeric percentages; preserving percent sign and formatted=false is appropriate.
One-pixel numeric label. The px abbreviation is already used in accepted Shan size labels; no lexical sentence needs translation.
One-decimal numeric value followed by supplied unit/text. Argument types/order and intervening space are exact; embedded unit text requires its own localization.

source_as_recorded: %1$s A separate recovery copy has been kept. Use File > Export recovery copy to save its ZIP. Extract canvas.png from it and load that image to use the normal resize options if needed.
target_as_recorded: %1$s သိမ်းၵေႃႇပီႇတႃႇဢဝ်ၶိုၼ်းၽႄဝႆႉယဝ်ႉ။ ၸႂ်ႉ ၾၢႆႇ > သူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇၵေႃႇပီႇတႃႇဢဝ်ၶိုၼ်း တႃႇသိမ်း ZIP ၶွင်မၼ်း။ ဢဝ် canvas.png ဢွၵ်ႇတီႈၼႂ်း ZIP ၼၼ်ႉသေ လူတ်ႇႁၢင်ႈၼၼ်ႉ၊ သင်လူဝ်ႇၼႆ ၸႂ်ႉတူဝ်လိူၵ်ႈလႅၵ်ႈၶၼၢတ်ႈဢၼ်ၸႂ်ႉယူႇၵူႈပွၵ်ႈ။
rationale: All propositions and order retained: successful separate preservation, menu export to save ZIP, extraction from that ZIP, loading the extracted image, optional ordinary resizing. Does not promise full editable-project import. Exact file name, archive identifier, placeholder and accepted menu text are retained. Stored separately is confirmed in EditorDraftRecovery.kt preserveForRecovery(retainOriginal=true).
General apply/use verb is suitable for putting current choices into effect in a dialog. Not employment or submitting an application.

target_as_recorded: ၸႂ်ႉၶွပ်ႇဢၼ်တင်ႈဝႆႉ
rationale: Relative clause identifies chosen bounds, not a border color; applyTrim caller commits them rather than merely previewing.

target_as_recorded: ႁဵတ်းၵၢၼ်တတ်းႁၢင်ႈ
rationale: Execution/commit action clearly distinguished from configuring or resetting crop. Uses independently reviewed crop phrase.

Failure to encode whole image for autosave is clear; data conversion purpose is distinct from ordinary Save destination handling. No implication that an earlier draft is lost. Fits canvas.png entry compression.
Metadata loan is primary-attested in MediaWiki image context. Missing object rather than disabled autosave or unreadable image; no claim of deletion.

target_as_recorded: ၽိၵ်ႉသႄႇလ်ၶွင်ၵၢၼ်သိမ်းႁင်းမၼ်းႁၢႆဝႆႉ။
rationale: Possessive compound associates pixel data with autosave; ႁၢႆဝႆႉ is missing/absent, not unreadable. Fits absent archive entry in AutosaveStore.kt. Pixel loan spelling independently verified in primary MediaWiki show-big-image-size; acceptance also evaluates this complete compound.

source_as_recorded: Autosave pixels could not be read.
target_as_recorded: ဢၢၼ်ႇၽိၵ်ႉသႄႇလ်ၶွင်ၵၢၼ်သိမ်းႁင်းမၼ်းဢမ်ႇလႆႈ။
rationale: ဢၢၼ်ႇ...ဢမ်ႇလႆႈ retains inability to read, distinct from absence. No added assertion of deletion. Matches decode failure after an archive entry has been found. Pixel loan independently checked; full construction is compositional.

ဢၼ်လိူၵ်ႈဝႆႉ is the selected thing/content, not the act of choosing. Entire clause clearly describes data conversion of that content for autosave, matching floating.png and preserving distinction from full image.
Correct expansion of English abbreviation using accepted foreground/background terminology. Compact label width has not been tested.
Functional label fits flood fill rather than a physical bucket or adding a palette color. Context establishes area-fill tool.

source_as_recorded: Cannot create the undo cache. Free some device storage and try again.
rationale: Descriptive cache phrase suits disk-backed undo data. Creation failure and retry are explicit; storage is not confused with RAM, and no instruction to clear undo history is invented. RasterHistory.kt directory-creation failure confirms context.
Drawing-area boundary phrase fits bounded bitmap/canvas and does not imply the entire phone screen or cloth. Boundary noun distinguishes this from size/scaling.
Descriptive canvas term is intelligible without a published technical neologism. In dimensions dialog this names extent, not scaling; distinct resize label remains available. Ellipsis retained.

target_as_recorded: ၶၼၢတ်ႈပိုၼ်ႉတီႈတႅမ်ႈႁၢင်ႈ
rationale: Same canvas extent phrase as ellipsis alias, preserving no-ellipsis title form.
Combines accepted B canvas paraphrase with view magnification; appropriate for viewport slider rather than dimensions editing.
Same zoom label with preserved formatted zoom-value string; no added percent sign that would duplicate caller formatting.

target_as_recorded: ယူႈယွမ်ႉသီ
rationale: Primary CLDR paintbrush implement noun fits brush tool-family category. Does not imply every member has identical stroke behavior. Exact noun matches independently second-checked ui_brush replacement.

source_as_recorded: Choose a smaller output copy. The source images and crop settings stay at their original resolution.
target_as_recorded: လိူၵ်ႈၶေႃႇပီႇသူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇဢၼ်လဵၵ်ႉလိူဝ်ၼႆႉ။ ႁၢင်ႈငဝ်ႈတိုၼ်းလႄႈၵၢၼ်တင်ႈတတ်းႁၢင်ႈ ယင်းယူႇတီႈၶၼၢတ်ႈၽိၵ်ႉသႄႇလ်ငဝ်ႈတိုၼ်း။
rationale: Smaller derived output is distinct from retained sources and original-resolution crop settings. No instruction to destructively resize sources.

source_as_recorded: This format must decode its source image or source tiles before resizing. A smaller output may still exceed available memory.
target_as_recorded: ပိူင်ၾၢႆႇၼႆႉ တေလႆႈထွတ်ႇၶူတ်ႉႁၢင်ႈငဝ်ႈတိုၼ်း ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် သုၼ်ႇႁၢင်ႈငဝ်ႈတိုၼ်း ဢွၼ်တၢင်းတေလႅၵ်ႈၶၼၢတ်ႈ။ ႁၢင်ႈသူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇဢၼ်လဵၵ်ႉလိူဝ်ၼၼ်ႉၵေႃႈ ယင်းၸၢင်ႈၸႂ်ႉမႅမ်ႇမူဝ်ႇရီႇလိူဝ်ဢၼ်မီးယူႇ။
rationale: Tile is described functionally as source-image section rather than physical tile. Mandatory decode-before-resize and MAY still exceed available memory retained; no guarantee that smaller output succeeds or fails.

target_as_recorded: တူပ်ႉပၢၼ်ႉသီဝႆႉ
rationale: UI collapse predicate is supported by primary MediaWiki usage. Applied to the palette panel, not deletion of colors or compression of the image.
ဝႆႉ makes selection an existing state, not an instruction to select the tool now. Category then tool placeholder order matches ToolCategoryButton.kt; following clause is the collapse action.
Transparent toolbox compound is suitable for tool-panel metaphor. Collapse is visibility/disclosure, not removal of tool functionality.

source_as_recorded: Colour palette. Tap for foreground; hold for background. Scroll for more colours.
rationale: Short tap and sustained press are distinct; foreground and background are not inverted. Scroll remains a separate gesture. Full action semantics match swatch click and long-click handlers in ClassicPaintActivity.kt.
Same gesture distinction as full palette instruction. Literal hash remains immediately before the single indexed string argument, matching hex-without-hash caller.

target_as_recorded: ႁူမ်ႈဢၼ်လိူၵ်ႈဝႆႉၶဝ်ႈၼႂ်းႁၢင်ႈ
rationale: Accurate functional description of committing floating content. For already nonfloating selection, content is already part of image and selection ends; phrase does not instruct deletion or clipboard copying.

target_as_recorded: ႁဵတ်းၵၢၼ်တတ်းႁၢင်ႈဢမ်ႇလႆႈ။
rationale: Negative ability describes failure to perform cropping, not a reason such as invalid bounds or missing clipboard data. Suitable for generic application error.

source_as_recorded: Could not export the recovery copy
rationale: Negative ability scopes export. Does not claim retained internal recovery data was deleted or that normal saving failed.

Broad cut-image verb is suitable in the crop-dialog context and names the image being cropped; ImageCropDialog.kt passes reference.name, not an amount or direction. It is not presented as the clipboard Cut command. Placeholder retained.
Explicit image object gives suitable short crop-action label in assembly UI. Context is crop rectangle adjustment, not clipboard extraction; no contrary operation is asserted.

source_as_recorded: Crop must stay inside the canvas.
rationale: Crop is a region; containment and obligation are explicit. Canvas boundary condition in PaintDocument.kt is retained rather than replaced with viewport visibility.

source_as_recorded: Crop preview. Drag an edge or corner; drag inside to move the crop.
rationale: Correct separate gesture targets: boundary/corner versus interior. Does not imply previewing applies a crop.
Explicit remaining selected region is decisive: this does not remove the selected content. Clear paraphrase of crop-to-selection even without an isolated specialized crop noun.

source_as_recorded: %1$d × %2$d pixels (%3$.2f MP) exceeds the current safe editing budget of %4$.2f MP. AN Paint keeps the complete image in memory and reserves space for transforms and selections. Available memory determines this budget. The operation was stopped before allocating the oversized bitmap. No automatic resizing was applied.
target_as_recorded: %1$d × %2$d ၽိၵ်ႉသႄႇလ် (%3$.2f MP) ပူၼ်ႉၶေႃႈမၵ်းၶၼ်ႈတႃႇမႄးလွတ်ႈၽေးယၢမ်းလဵဝ် %4$.2f MP။ AN Paint သိမ်းႁၢင်ႈတင်းႁၢင်ႈဝႆႉၼႂ်းမႅမ်ႇမူဝ်ႇရီႇ လႄႈဝႆႉတီႈဝၢင်ႈတႃႇလႅၵ်ႈႁၢင်ႈလႄႈလိူၵ်ႈပိုၼ်ႉတီႈ။ မႅမ်ႇမူဝ်ႇရီႇဢၼ်ၸႂ်ႉလႆႈ မၵ်းၶေႃႈမၵ်းၶၼ်ႈၼႆႉ။ ဢွၼ်တၢင်းတေၸတ်းမႅမ်ႇမူဝ်ႇရီႇပၼ်ႁၢင်ႈၽိၵ်ႉသႄႇလ်ဢၼ်ယႂ်ႇပူၼ်ႉၼၼ်ႉ လႆႈၵိုတ်းၵၢၼ်ၼႆႉဝႆႉယဝ်ႉ။ ဢမ်ႇလႆႈလႅၵ်ႈၶၼၢတ်ႈႁင်းမၼ်း။
rationale: All warning propositions retained. Transform phrase is broad image-changing action in this memory-reserve context, not file-format conversion. BEFORE allocation relation and no-resize negation explicit. Four indexed format tokens preserve integer/2-decimal types and MP.

Pixel count noun counts pixels, not storage bytes. Four exact indexed numeric placeholders retain d, grouped ,d and .2f precision. Multiplication, middle dot, px, MP and parentheses retained. Contains translated lexical label, so separate from format-only templates.

target_as_recorded: ၵၢၼ်တင်ႈတႃႇတႅမ်ႈႁၢင်ႈ…
rationale: Settings noun and purpose clause describe drawing options; no implication of changing the image dimensions. Matches drawing-settings dialog action. Ellipsis retained.

target_as_recorded: ၵၢၼ်တင်ႈတႃႇတႅမ်ႈႁၢင်ႈ
rationale: Same natural compositional label as dialog-opening alias, with source-specific absence of ellipsis.
Edit verb and established background noun are appropriate for abbreviated UI; does not say erase. Ellipsis retained.
Compositional drawing-area noun is appropriate for the bounded surface. No need to assert that it is an established technical term; no garment or device-screen meaning is introduced.
Uses the catalogue foreground label in the color-edit context. Omission of color follows English and is disambiguated by the interface, not a substitution of background.

target_as_recorded: ပိၼ်ႈ / ပၼ်ႇ
rationale: Distinct mirror and rotate verbs with retained slash. Related choices are not collapsed into one operation.

source_as_recorded: Enter a trim amount for every edge.
target_as_recorded: သႂ်ႇတၢင်းၼမ်ဢၼ်တေတတ်းဢွၵ်ႇတႃႇၶွပ်ႇၵူႈၽၢႆႇ။
rationale: Exact reviewer-proposed B correction has independent author acceptance in trim-secondcheck-receipt.tsv. Amount-to-remove phrase and every-edge quantifier are preserved; not a command to trim immediately.

target_as_recorded: သႂ်ႇတၢင်းၼမ်ဢၼ်တေတတ်းဢွၵ်ႇတင်းသီႇဢၼ်။
rationale: Exact reviewer-proposed B correction has independent author acceptance in trim-secondcheck-receipt.tsv. Four counts required trim values, not pixels and not an upper bound.

source_as_recorded: Enter positive dimensions that resolve to at least 1 pixel.
target_as_recorded: သႂ်ႇၶၼၢတ်ႈဢၼ်ယႂ်ႇလိူဝ်သုၼ် လႄႈမိူဝ်ႈပိၼ်ႇပဵၼ်ၽိၵ်ႉသႄႇလ်ၼၼ်ႉ လႆႈ 1 ဢၼ် ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် ၼမ်လိူဝ်ၼၼ်ႉ။
rationale: Retains BOTH strict positivity and minimum resolved pixel result. Does not accept a positive fraction that rounds below one pixel.
Expansion concerns visibility/extent of palette panel. Does not instruct changing gamut or color intensity. Complements accepted collapse phrase.
Existing selection state plus separate expand action; no source argument omitted/reversed. Expansion is the disclosure action in this button context.
Same tool-panel compound and proper opposite disclosure action. No instruction to enlarge stroke size or activate every tool.

target_as_recorded: သူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇပဵၼ်…
rationale: Export/send-out verb plus as construction; distinct from သိမ်းပဵၼ် Save as. Ellipsis retained.

source_as_recorded: Export an icon, Base64 text or ASCII art. Exporting keeps the current image and its Save destination unchanged.
target_as_recorded: သူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇပဵၼ်ဢၢႆႇၵွၼ်ႇ၊ လိၵ်ႈ Base64 ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် ႁၢင်ႈဢၼ်တႅမ်ႈလူၺ်ႈတူဝ်လိၵ်ႈ ASCII။ ၵၢၼ်သူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇၼႆႉ ဢမ်ႇလႅၵ်ႈလၢႆႈႁၢင်ႈယၢမ်းလဵဝ် လႄႈတီႈသိမ်းမၼ်း။
rationale: Icon noun independently confirmed in primary VisualEditor Shan visualeditor-mweditmodeve-popup-body, paired with English digital-icon context. Appropriate to exported ICO icon image, not religious portrait or profile picture. Both unchanged-current-image and unchanged-Save-destination retained; export is distinct from Save. Original contextual ICO paraphrase was defensible but is superseded by this more direct exact wording.
